title: Spread toward equal days of cover
story: Three markets at 5, 15 and 20 days, 300 cases to share. Supply lifts them together to about 23 days each: (L-5)+(L-15)+(L-20) = 30 days x 10 cs/day, so L = 23.3. All three still run out before the 28-day run. The two deep cuts that run out go to approval; the market getting 61% does not.
